records.jp: 愛央。そろそろ食事の時間だから、<CR>みんなを呼んできてくれる？
records.en_original: Ao, it's almost time to eat. Would you go and bring everyone in?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, it's almost time to eat. Would you go and bring everyone in?
records.en: Ao. It's about time to eat, so<CR>could you go call everyone?

records.jp: え、やったぁ！<CR>りょーかい！
records.en_original: Ooh, yay! I'm on it!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, yay! I'm on it!
records.en: Oh, yay!<CR>Roger!

records.jp: えへへ。今日は美弦さんのカレーだね！<CR>陽桜莉さんの好物でしょ？　私も好きなんだぁ～
records.en_original: Hehe! We're having Mio's curry today! This is your favorite meal, isn't it, Hiori? I can see why!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe! We're having Mio's curry today! This is your favorite meal, isn't it, Hiori? I can see why!
records.en: Ehehe. It's Mio-san's curry today!<CR>It's your favorite, right, Hiori-san? I like it too~

records.jp: うん。でもさ……<CR>お姉ちゃん、こればっか作りすぎだよぉ……
records.en_original: It is, but... Mio, you make this way too often.
records.en_auxiliary: It is, but... Mio, you make this way too often.
records.en: Yeah. But, you know...<CR>Onee-chan makes it way too often...

records.jp: え……そ、そう……なの？
records.en_original: What...? D-do I?
records.en_auxiliary: What...? D-do I?
records.en: Huh... I-I do...?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは、同じものが続いて<CR>食べ飽きてしまう……ということでしょうか？
records.en_original: Hiori has eaten the same meal too many times and has become bored of it. Is that correct?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori has eaten the same meal too many times and has become bored of it. Is that correct?
records.en: Does that mean Hiori-san gets tired of eating<CR>the same thing over and over...?

records.jp: あ、いや、そうじゃなくってね。<CR>みんなが飽きちゃうんじゃないかなぁって……
records.en_original: N-no, that's not what I meant. I was just worried everyone else would get sick of it.
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, that's not what I meant. I was just worried everyone else would get sick of it.
records.en: Ah, no, that's not it.<CR>I just thought everyone else might get tired of it...

records.jp: あたしは別にへーき！<CR>カレーって好きだしねー
records.en_original: I don't mind at all! I love curry!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't mind at all! I love curry!
records.en: I'm totally fine with it!<CR>I like curry, after all.

records.jp: わたしもです。同じカレーでも、人によって<CR>味が違うのが楽しいですよ
records.en_original: So do I. It's interesting how the flavor of the same curry changes depending on who makes it.
records.en_auxiliary: So do I. It's interesting how the flavor of the same curry changes depending on who makes it.
records.en: Me too. Even if it's curry, it's fun how<CR>it tastes different depending on who makes it.

records.jp: そ、そっかぁ……。ならいいけど……<CR>
records.en_original: O-oh. Well then it's fine, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh. Well then it's fine, I guess.
records.en: I-I see...<CR>Well, if that's the case...

records.jp: ほら、陽桜莉の分、よそっておいたから。<CR>水とスプーンも後で持っていく
records.en_original: I got you a plate, Hiori. I'll bring you a spoon and a glass of water in a second.
records.en_auxiliary: I got you a plate, Hiori. I'll bring you a spoon and a glass of water in a second.
records.en: Here, I already served your portion, Hiori.<CR>I'll bring your water and spoon in a bit.

records.jp: あ、ありがとう……
records.en_original: Th-thanks...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thanks...
records.en: Ah, thanks...

records.jp: あれ？　えっと……
records.en_original: Oh? Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? Um...
records.en: Huh? Um...

records.jp: ドレッシングね、忘れてたわ。<CR>えっと、確か……
records.en_original: Salad dressing! I forgot. I believe it was in...
records.en_auxiliary: Salad dressing! I forgot. I believe it was in...
records.en: The dressing. I forgot it.<CR>Um, I think it was...

records.jp: だ、大丈夫、自分で探すよ！　もう、過保護すぎ！
records.en_original: It's fine, I'll look for it myself! You're so overbearing!
records.en_auxiliary: It's fine, I'll look for it myself! You're so overbearing!
records.en: I-It's okay, I'll look for it myself! Geez, you're too overprotective!

records.jp: え……そ、そうかしら
records.en_original: Oh... Am I?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... Am I?
records.en: Oh... I-I wonder if I am.

records.jp: ん？　詩さん、さっきから不思議そうな<CR>顔してるけど、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Uta? You look confused. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta? You look confused. What's up?
records.en: Hm? Uta-san, you've looked puzzled for a while now.<CR>What's wrong?

records.jp: 実際、不思議なんです。美弦さんは、陽桜莉さんの<CR>考えが読み取れるんですか？
records.en_original: Well, I am. Can Mio read Hiori's mind?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I am. Can Mio read Hiori's mind?
records.en: I truly am puzzled. Can Mio-san<CR>read what Hiori-san is thinking?

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ……ぷっ！　あはは！　違うよー！<CR>お姉ちゃん、超能力は使えないもん
records.en_original: Pff! Ahahaha! No way! Mio's not psychic or anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Pff! Ahahaha! No way! Mio's not psychic or anything.
records.en: ...Pfft! Ahaha! No, that's not it!<CR>Onee-chan can't use psychic powers.

records.jp: ええ。考えを読み取るなんてできないわ。ただ……<CR>陽桜莉とはずっと一緒にいるから
records.en_original: No, I'm not. It's just that I've always been with Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm not. It's just that I've always been with Hiori.
records.en: No, I can't read her mind. It's just...<CR>I've been with Hiori for so long.

records.jp: 自然と相手の考えることが分かるようになるの。<CR>それは、相手がだれであってもきっと同じ
records.en_original: So I naturally began to pick up on what's on her mind. I'm sure anyone would be able to do the same.
records.en_auxiliary: So I naturally began to pick up on what's on her mind. I'm sure anyone would be able to do the same.
records.en: You naturally start to understand what the other person is thinking.<CR>I'm sure it'd be the same no matter who it was.

records.jp: ……？<CR>すみません。ますます分からなくなりました
records.en_original: Hm...? I'm sorry. I don't understand.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm...? I'm sorry. I don't understand.
records.en: ...?<CR>I'm sorry. I understand even less now.

records.jp: 誰かと長く一緒にいると、本当に相手の考えが<CR>自然に分かるようになるものなのでしょうか？
records.en_original: Anybody would be able to know what another person is thinking if they spend enough time with them?
records.en_auxiliary: Anybody would be able to know what another person is thinking if they spend enough time with them?
records.en: If you spend a long time with someone, do you really<CR>come to naturally understand what they are thinking?

records.jp: うーん。えっとさ……
records.en_original: Umm, well...
records.en_auxiliary: Umm, well...
records.en: Hmm. Well...

records.jp: 見てて思うんだ。陽桜莉さんはさ、美弦さんの<CR>ことを本当に信頼してるんだなーって
records.en_original: You know, this got me thinking. You really trust Mio, don't you, Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: You know, this got me thinking. You really trust Mio, don't you, Hiori?
records.en: Watching you two, I just think...<CR>Hiori-san really does trust Mio-san.

records.jp: えへへ。わかる？
records.en_original: Eheheh... Can you tell?
records.en_auxiliary: Eheheh... Can you tell?
records.en: Ehehe. Can you tell?

records.jp: そりゃ、羨ましくなるくらいにね
records.en_original: It almost makes me jealous.
records.en_auxiliary: It almost makes me jealous.
records.en: Enough to make me jealous.

records.jp: 私にとってお姉ちゃんて、誰よりも私のことを<CR>想ってくれる人だからね
records.en_original: Mio understands me better than anyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: Mio understands me better than anyone else.
records.en: To me, Onee-chan is the person who<CR>cares about me more than anyone else.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんだって、負けないくらい美弦さんを<CR>想ってるじゃん
records.en_original: And you seem to really care for her as well, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: And you seem to really care for her as well, Hiori.
records.en: And you care about Mio-san just as much,<CR>Hiori-san.

records.jp: うん。いろんなことがあったけど、ふたりで<CR>乗り越えてきて、絆が強くなった気がするよ
records.en_original: Yeah. We've been through a lot, and overcoming so much together has made our bond really strong.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We've been through a lot, and overcoming so much together has made our bond really strong.
records.en: Yeah. A lot has happened, but we've gotten through it together,<CR>and I feel like our bond has grown stronger.

records.jp: 美弦さんって、陽桜莉さんのことをすっごく<CR>理解してるんだなぁって
records.en_original: You know, this got me thinking. You seem to understand Hiori really well, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, this got me thinking. You seem to understand Hiori really well, Mio.
records.en: It really makes me think Mio-san understands<CR>Hiori-san so well.

records.jp: 大切な妹だもの。当然よ<CR>……と、言いたいところだけど
records.en_original: She is my sister after all. It's only right that I do... Or that's at least what I'd like to say.
records.en_auxiliary: She is my sister after all. It's only right that I do... Or that's at least what I'd like to say.
records.en: She's my precious younger sister. Of course I do...<CR>is what I'd like to say, but...

records.jp: 理解しているつもりになっていないか、時折心配に<CR>なるけれど、より理解したいと思ってるわ
records.en_original: I sometimes worry if I've only convinced myself that I know her. I'd like to know her even better.
records.en_auxiliary: I sometimes worry if I've only convinced myself that I know her. I'd like to know her even better.
records.en: Sometimes I worry that I've only convinced myself I understand her,<CR>but I do want to understand her better.

records.jp: そういうとこ、美弦さんらしいなぁ。<CR>陽桜莉さんは幸せ者だよ！
records.en_original: That's so like you, Mio. Hiori is lucky to have you for a sister!
records.en_auxiliary: That's so like you, Mio. Hiori is lucky to have you for a sister!
records.en: That part is so like you, Mio-san.<CR>Hiori-san's a lucky girl!

records.jp: 幸せ者なのは私の方。陽桜莉が私の手を離さずに<CR>いてくれたから、今があるのだもの
records.en_original: I'm the lucky one. I am who I am thanks to Hiori always being there for me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the lucky one. I am who I am thanks to Hiori always being there for me.
records.en: I am the lucky one. The reason I have the present I do<CR>is because Hiori never let go of my hand.

records.jp: ふたりの歴史が作った大事な絆だね
records.en_original: Sounds like you two share a very special bond.
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds like you two share a very special bond.
records.en: It's an important bond built by the history you two share.

records.jp: 私、一人っ子だからよく分からないとこあるけど、<CR>美弦さんと陽桜莉さんを見てるとさ……
records.en_original: I'm an only child so I can't say for certain, but looking at Mio and Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm an only child so I can't say for certain, but looking at Mio and Hiori...
records.en: I'm an only child, so there are parts I don't really get,<CR>but when I look at Mio-san and Hiori-san...

records.jp: 姉妹の絆って、特別なんだなぁって思うんだ。<CR>姉妹がみんなそうだとも思わないけど
records.en_original: It makes me think that the bond between sisters is very special. Not to say that all sisters are like them.
records.en_auxiliary: It makes me think that the bond between sisters is very special. Not to say that all sisters are like them.
records.en: it makes me feel like the bond between sisters is something special.<CR>Not that I think all sisters are like that, though.

records.jp: それは……私もおふたりを見ていて分かります。<CR>お互いをとても大切に想っていると
records.en_original: That much, I understand. It is easy to see that they care very much about each other.
records.en_auxiliary: That much, I understand. It is easy to see that they care very much about each other.
records.en: That much... I can understand just from watching you two.<CR>That you care very deeply for one another.

records.jp: 以前は、おふたりをそこまで強く結びつけるものが<CR>何なのか、よく分かりませんでしたが……
records.en_original: It wasn't so long ago that I did not know what made them so close.
records.en_auxiliary: It wasn't so long ago that I did not know what made them so close.
records.en: Before, I didn't really understand what it was<CR>that bound you two together so strongly, but...

records.jp: 少し……うらやましいです
records.en_original: But now, I...I envy them.
records.en_auxiliary: But now, I...I envy them.
records.en: I'm a little... envious.

records.jp: 美弦さんと陽桜莉さんは、長い時間をかけて<CR>ふたりの絆を確かなものにしてったんだね……
records.en_original: Mio and Hiori, you've built your relationship into something really strong over time.
records.en_auxiliary: Mio and Hiori, you've built your relationship into something really strong over time.
records.en: Mio-san and Hiori-san spent a long time<CR>making your bond into something certain...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんがドレッシングを使いたい時が<CR>分かるくらいにさ
records.en_original: Strong enough to sense when Hiori wants some salad dressing.
records.en_auxiliary: Strong enough to sense when Hiori wants some salad dressing.
records.en: to the point where you can tell<CR>when Hiori-san wants dressing.

records.jp: ドレッシングの話で落とされると、私と陽桜莉の絆が<CR>安っぽく聞こえるのだけど
records.en_original: That makes it sound like my relationship with Hiori is made up of cheap tricks like that.
records.en_auxiliary: That makes it sound like my relationship with Hiori is made up of cheap tricks like that.
records.en: If you undercut it with the dressing story,<CR>it makes the bond between Hiori and me sound cheap.

records.jp: あはは！　いーじゃん。<CR>ドレッシングで通じ合えるくらい仲良しってことで！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Oh, come on. It still shows how close we are!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Oh, come on. It still shows how close we are!
records.en: Ahaha! That's fine, isn't it?<CR>It just means you're close enough to understand each other through dressing!

records.jp: ……私も、そんな絆をいつか築きたい。<CR>不可能でも、そう思いました
records.en_original: I would like to develop a bond like that someday, no matter how improbable it may be.
records.en_auxiliary: I would like to develop a bond like that someday, no matter how improbable it may be.
records.en: ...I too would like to build a bond like that someday.<CR>Even if it may be impossible, that is what I thought.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんだって、絶対に作れるよ！<CR>大事な人と通じ合えるような、そんな絆！
records.en_original: You'll definitely be able to, Uta! You'll have a great connection with someone you care about!
records.en_auxiliary: You'll definitely be able to, Uta! You'll have a great connection with someone you care about!
records.en: You'll definitely be able to, Uta-chan!<CR>A bond where you can understand each other with someone precious!

records.jp: 私もそう思うよ、詩さん。<CR>詩さんが大切な人と出会えた時に、きっと！
records.en_original: I think so too, Uta. I'm sure it will happen when you meet someone like that!
records.en_auxiliary: I think so too, Uta. I'm sure it will happen when you meet someone like that!
records.en: I think so too, Uta-san.<CR>When you meet someone precious, definitely!

records.jp: あ……星崎さんが困っている時なら、<CR>何となく分かるようになりました
records.en_original: Oh... Come to think of it, I've learnt how to tell when Ao is troubled.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... Come to think of it, I've learnt how to tell when Ao is troubled.
records.en: Ah... If it's when Hoshizaki-san is in trouble,<CR>I've somehow become able to tell.

records.jp: え？　私！？<CR>ていうか、なんでよりによって困ってる時なのー！？
records.en_original: What? Me?! Wait, why only when I'm troubled?!
records.en_auxiliary: What? Me?! Wait, why only when I'm troubled?!
records.en: Huh? Me!?<CR>And why is it specifically when I am in trouble!?
